agents.name: Regime Analyst
agents.skill: built in (SPY, QQQ, IWM, VIX, TLT, GLD)
agents.method: Price against 50 and 200-day averages, VIX level

agents.name: Chart Scanner
agents.method: scan.py daily on the watchlist: 20-day breakout, bull flag, MA20 reclaim, oversold, oversold bounce

agents.name: News Monitor
agents.method: news.py headlines and price moves for candidates and holdings

agents.name: News Judge
agents.method: Reads each name's own headlines; returns event-risk probability, direction and materiality. Event risk over the limit blocks the ticket.

agents.name: Cross-Market Analyst
agents.method: Trend, stretch in units of own volatility, oversold base rate, and the links between crypto, stocks, gold, yields, the dollar and credit

agents.name: Arbitrage Scout
agents.skill: built in (Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Gemini public tickers)
agents.method: Cheapest ask against richest bid across four exchanges for BTC and ETH, net of entry-tier taker fees; read-only

agents.name: Bull Researcher
agents.method: Strongest case for the trade from checkable facts

agents.name: Bear Researcher
agents.method: Strongest case against, including event risk and thin history

agents.name: Trade Planner
agents.method: Stop under ATR, target as a multiple of risk, set before entry

agents.name: Time Machine
agents.method: 10,000 seeded replays of the stock's own daily returns, plus every past time the setup fired

agents.name: Day-Trading Lab
agents.method: Tests first-hour breakout, gap fade and trend-day rules per symbol over 60 sessions, flat by the close, with costs and a t-statistic

agents.name: Risk Manager
agents.method: Size to max loss, cap position and cash, then PASS or BLOCK with every reason

agents.name: Portfolio Manager
agents.method: Reads the ticket and types yes or no. Only a yes moves paper cash.

agents.name: Strategist
agents.method: Writes the strategy and places its own paper bets in a separate model book, judged against SPY and against your book

agents.name: Journal
agents.method: Marks paper positions on daily closes, Brier score of the Time Machine's odds

agents.name: Hindsight Analyst
agents.method: Replays every past firing of every rule on the watchlist with the desk's plan, split by market regime: what would have been a good decision

agents.name: Arena Referee
agents.method: Runs trend, mean reversion, dual momentum, breakout, crypto trend, all weather and buy-and-hold on one year with costs; scores every agent's holdings forward each day; weights them by trailing Sharpe

agents.name: Editor
agents.method: Checks every brief, call and debate for dashes, stock AI words, overlong sentences and staged contrasts; Claude does the judgment pass

agents.name: Design Critic
agents.method: Holds the feel contract (press 160ms, entrances 500ms, charts never animate) and runs one Impeccable finish after a real visual look

funds.expertise: Futures-style trend following applied to large-cap stocks and ETFs
workflow: Screen every asset against its 50 and 200-day averages
Hold only what is above both
Size by inverse volatility so each position risks about the same
Exit the day an asset loses either average
funds.edge: Big trends last longer than most people expect; cutting losers early keeps the losses small.
funds.risk: No position above 25%. Cash when nothing trends.
funds.fails_when: Markets chop sideways: it buys late and sells early, again and again.
coaching: Best risk-adjusted record (Sharpe 1.68): first in line for the 20-session forward test.

funds.expertise: Buying two-day selloffs in stocks that are still in long-term uptrends
workflow: Keep only stocks above their 200-day average
Buy when the 2-day RSI drops below 10
Hold until the 2-day RSI recovers above 70
Never more than 20% in one name
funds.edge: Sharp dips in strong stocks are usually overreactions that partly reverse within days.
funds.risk: Long-term trend filter first; small positions; no averaging down.
funds.fails_when: A dip is the start of a real decline: news, earnings or a regime change.
coaching: Traded on 157 of 252 days with a Sharpe of 0.22: costs eat the edge. Rebalance weekly, or only when a weight drifts more than 5 points.
Positive, but 5.0% trails SPY's 21.6%: the rule has not yet earned its complexity.

funds.expertise: Ranking assets by six-month return and holding only leaders that beat cash
workflow: Rank the universe by six-month return
Keep the top three
Require each to beat the cash yield over the same period
Hold cash if none qualifies
funds.edge: Winners keep winning for months; the cash test sidesteps long bear markets.
funds.risk: Equal weight across three names; absolute momentum check against cash.
funds.fails_when: Leadership flips fast, as in sharp rotations: it holds last quarter's winners into the turn.
coaching: Best risk-adjusted record (Sharpe 1.21): first in line for the 20-session forward test.

funds.expertise: Entering new 20-day highs and riding them until a 10-day low
workflow: Buy a new 20-day high
Stay in while price holds above the 10-day low
Spread risk across up to five names
Exit on the 10-day low
funds.edge: Breakouts catch the start of new trends early.
funds.risk: 20% per name; the 10-day low is the stop.
funds.fails_when: Breakouts fail in a range-bound market, which this year's record shows clearly.
coaching: Positive, but 11.9% trails SPY's 21.6%: the rule has not yet earned its complexity.

funds.expertise: Bitcoin and Ether, held only in uptrends
workflow: Check Bitcoin and Ether against their 50-day averages
Hold whichever is above
Split equally
Cash otherwise
funds.edge: Crypto trends are strong and long; staying out of downtrends avoids the worst drawdowns.
funds.risk: Never more than two assets; cash when both are below trend.
funds.fails_when: Sharp whipsaws around the 50-day average, common after big drops.
coaching: Worst drop -27.6%: add a regime filter (cash when SPY is below its 200-day average) or a portfolio stop.
Lost to cash after costs (Sharpe -0.85). Keep it in the arena as a control, with no capital.

funds.expertise: A Dalio-style mix meant to survive growth and inflation surprises
workflow: Hold 30% stocks, 40% long Treasuries, 15% gold, 15% cash
Rebalance to the mix
funds.edge: No forecasts: different assets win in different regimes.
funds.risk: Fixed weights; no single bet dominates.
funds.fails_when: Rising real rates, when stocks, bonds and gold fall together. That is today's regime.
coaching: Best risk-adjusted record (Sharpe 1.75): first in line for the 20-session forward test.

funds.expertise: Owning the market at the lowest cost
workflow: Buy SPY
Hold
funds.edge: Low cost and no decisions to get wrong.
funds.fails_when: Bear markets, which it rides all the way down.
coaching: Worst drop -36.8%: add a regime filter (cash when SPY is below its 200-day average) or a portfolio stop.
